title: ProductFunctionalSuitability
description: TOGAF-sourced quality archetype — Functional Suitability viability dimension. Measures whether the system provides functions that meet stated and implied needs. Rootless archetype — transversal to all governed entities. ISO 25010 mapping: Functional Suitability (Completeness, Correctness, Appropriateness). Source framework: TOGAF (Architecture Principles) + ISO/IEC 25010.

completeness.description: Degree to which the set of functions covers all specified tasks and user objectives (0-100%). Norm example: FunctionalSuitability.completeness >= 95.

correctness.description: Degree to which the system provides correct results with needed precision (0-100%). Norm example: FunctionalSuitability.correctness >= 99.

appropriateness.description: Degree to which functions facilitate accomplishment of specified tasks and objectives (0-100%). Norm example: FunctionalSuitability.appropriateness >= 90.
